build.script:
#!/bin/sh

# Build Image
docker build -t aliasproject/php:7.4-fpm-nginx php/7.4/fpm-nginx

# Build multiple architectures and push to Github
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64/v8,linux/amd64 --push -t ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:7.4-fpm-nginx php/7.4/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to alias-cloud
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/alias-cloud/php:7.4-fpm-nginx php/7.4/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to alias-project-corp
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/alias-project-corp/php:8.0-fpm-nginx php/8.0/fpm-nginx
